verdict.rationale: Devin's docs directly say it can tackle Linear/Jira tickets, so the core story is claimed first-party. That support is a single marketing-level line with no documented mechanism for assigning a task from inside the issue or ticket. Slack/Teams thread tagging is a related but different entry point, and MCP issue-tracker connectivity is only a developer building block, so neither adds credit. Missing for 10: documented workflow for assigning or triggering Devin from within a Linear/Jira/GitHub issue, details on how ticket context becomes the task spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets
